name: streaming_text
description: SSE text streaming with token usage extraction
validates: Provider can parse SSE text deltas and extract token usage from message_delta

name: tool_call_roundtrip
description: Single tool_use block, tool result submission, final text synthesis
validates: Provider extracts tool_use content blocks, caller feeds tool_result, provider returns synthesis

name: multi_tool_turn
description: Two tool_use blocks in one assistant response with call_id correlation
validates: Provider extracts multiple tool_use blocks and correlates results by call_id

name: token_usage_reporting
description: Token usage fields including cache tokens extracted from response
validates: Provider extracts input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens

name: streaming_tool_call
description: Tool use streamed via input_json_delta chunks with partial JSON reassembly
validates: Provider reassembles partial JSON from input_json_delta events into complete tool call
